description: The acceptance file of Proof-of-Done, version 1 (plan task pod-20, docs/PROOF-ACCEPTANCE.md): the strict YAML subset (lib/proof/yaml-subset.mjs), the schema, the baseline-only rule and proposeAcceptance (lib/proof/acceptance.mjs) and the trust store (lib/proof/trust-store.mjs), judged by tests/verify-proof-acceptance.mjs.

mutations.name: PA-criteria-from-current
mutations.what: resolveAcceptance takes the criteria from the CURRENT file (an agent edit becomes the source)

patches.old: const parsed = baseline === null || baseline === undefined ? null : parseAcceptance(baseline);
patches.new: const parsed = current === null || current === undefined ? (baseline == null ? null : parseAcceptance(baseline)) : parseAcceptance(current);

mutations.name: PA-trust-current-sha
mutations.what: the trust check asks about the current file's sha256 instead of the baseline's

mutations.name: PA-runnable-when-untrusted
mutations.what: every baseline check is runnable even when the file is not trusted

mutations.name: PA-truthy-trust
mutations.what: any truthy answer of the store counts as trusted (a store that returns a string or an object)

mutations.name: PA-no-edit-flag
mutations.what: an edit is never reported

mutations.name: PA-removed-not-reported
mutations.what: a deleted criterion is not listed

mutations.name: PA-changed-not-reported
mutations.what: a weakened criterion is not listed

mutations.name: PA-protected-section-ignored
mutations.what: dropping a protected glob is not reported

mutations.name: PA-unparseable-keeps-nothing
mutations.what: an unparseable edit lists no removed criterion

mutations.name: PA-same-bytes-by-length
mutations.what: two files of the same length count as unchanged

mutations.name: PA-broken-baseline-is-empty
mutations.what: a baseline that does not read is read as no criteria

patches.old: const parsed = baseline === null || baseline === undefined ? null : parseAcceptance(baseline);
patches.new: let parsed = null; try { parsed = baseline === null || baseline === undefined ? null : parseAcceptance(baseline); } catch {}
let before = EMPTY; try { before = absent(baseline) ? EMPTY : parseAcceptance(baseline); } catch {}

mutations.name: PA-cwd-dotdot-allowed
mutations.what: a `..` segment in cwd is accepted

mutations.name: PA-cwd-absolute-allowed
mutations.what: absolute, drive and home paths are accepted as cwd

patches.old: if (/^[\\/~]/.test(value) || value.includes(':') || path.win32.isAbsolute(value) || path.posix.isAbsolute(value)) fail(node.line, reason, value);

mutations.name: PA-drive-relative-allowed
mutations.what: a drive-relative path (`D:tools`) is accepted

mutations.name: PA-unknown-keys-allowed
mutations.what: unknown keys are ignored

mutations.name: PA-duplicate-id-allowed
mutations.what: two criteria may share an id

mutations.name: PA-any-version
mutations.what: any version number is accepted

mutations.name: PA-empty-criteria-allowed
mutations.what: `criteria:` with nothing is accepted

mutations.name: PA-checks-and-manual
mutations.what: a criterion may have both checks and manual (the manual part hides the checks)

mutations.name: PA-timeout-unbounded
mutations.what: timeout has no lower bound

patches.old: if (node.value < min || node.value > max) fail(node.line, 'bad_value', `${what} must be ${min} to ${max}`);
patches.new: if (node.value > max) fail(node.line, 'bad_value', `${what} must be ${min} to ${max}`);

mutations.name: PA-protected-outside
mutations.what: a protected glob may leave the workspace

mutations.name: PA-propose-unprotected
mutations.what: the proposed file does not protect .chatmcp/

mutations.name: PA-propose-unquoted
mutations.what: proposed commands are written unquoted (a command with YAML characters would not read back)

mutations.name: PA-hidden-unchecked
mutations.what: hidden characters reach the commands and texts (Trojan Source)

mutations.name: PA-hidden-no-controls
mutations.what: control characters from an escape (ESC, CR, NUL, C1) are allowed

mutations.name: PA-hidden-no-default-ignorable
mutations.what: default-ignorable code points that are not format characters (variation selectors) are allowed

mutations.name: PA-hidden-no-noncharacter
mutations.what: noncharacters are allowed

mutations.name: PA-line-break-outside-block
mutations.what: a quoted "\n" hides a second command line

patches.old: if (node.style !== 'block' && node.value.includes('\n')) fail(node.line, 'hidden_character', `a line break in ${what}`);

mutations.name: PA-ambiguous-comment-off
mutations.what: a plain command cut at " #" inside a quote is accepted

mutations.name: PA-ambiguous-any-comment
mutations.what: every plain command with a comment is refused (`npm test # x` too)

mutations.name: PA-setup-not-a-command
mutations.what: setup steps are read as plain text, not as commands

mutations.name: PA-device-names-allowed
mutations.what: a cwd may name a Windows device or end in a dot or space

mutations.name: PA-trailing-dot-allowed
mutations.what: a cwd part may end in a dot or a space

mutations.name: PA-device-without-extension-only
mutations.what: `nul.txt` is not a device

mutations.name: PA-device-any-prefix
mutations.what: a folder that only starts like a device (`console`, `com10`) is refused

mutations.name: PA-propose-throws
mutations.what: a discovered check that the reader refuses makes proposeAcceptance throw

mutations.name: PA-propose-skip-unreported
mutations.what: a skipped check is not reported

patches.old: skipped.push({ command: check.command, from: check.from, reason: error.reason });

mutations.name: PA-propose-empty-when-all-skipped
mutations.what: when every check is skipped no manual criterion is written (an invalid file)

mutations.name: YS-c1-allowed
mutations.what: raw C1 controls (U+0080-U+009F) pass the YAML layer

mutations.name: YS-line-separator-allowed
mutations.what: raw U+2028 and U+2029 pass the YAML layer

mutations.name: YS-comment-flag-off
mutations.what: a plain scalar never says that a comment was removed

mutations.name: TS-corrupt-reads-entries
mutations.what: a store with a malformed entry keeps its other entries (and a `*` key)

mutations.name: TS-version-ignored
mutations.what: the version of the store is not checked

mutations.name: TS-extra-keys-allowed
mutations.what: extra top-level keys (such as `all: true`) are ignored

mutations.name: TS-no-size-limit
mutations.what: a store of any size is read

patches.old: if (bytes.length > TRUST_STORE_MAX_BYTES) return { entries: new Map(), state: 'corrupt' };

mutations.name: TS-entry-fields-unchecked
mutations.what: an entry without approvedBy or at counts

mutations.name: TS-no-serialisation
mutations.what: writes are not serialised (concurrent read-modify-write loses entries)

mutations.name: TS-queue-per-object
mutations.what: the queue is per store object, so two objects on the same folder race

patches.new: const objectKey = file + randomUUID(); const lock = (task) => serialised(objectKey, task);

mutations.name: TS-revoke-noop
mutations.what: revoke does not remove the entry

mutations.name: TS-case-sensitive
mutations.what: an upper-case digest is not the same digest

mutations.name: TS-corrupt-overwritten
mutations.what: trusting over a corrupt store throws it away instead of keeping it aside

mutations.name: TS-approver-unchecked
mutations.what: trust() accepts an empty approver

mutations.name: YS-anchor-allowed
mutations.what: an anchor is read as part of a plain value

mutations.name: YS-alias-allowed
mutations.what: an alias is read as text

mutations.name: YS-tag-allowed
mutations.what: a tag is read as text

mutations.name: YS-duplicate-key-overwrites
mutations.what: a duplicate key silently replaces the first

mutations.name: YS-tabs-allowed
mutations.what: tabs in indentation are not refused

mutations.name: YS-second-document
mutations.what: a later `---` or `...` is skipped like a comment

mutations.name: YS-no-size-limit
mutations.what: a file of any size is read

mutations.name: YS-no-depth-limit
mutations.what: nesting is not bounded

patches.old: if (depth > this.maxDepth) throw new YamlSubsetError(at + 1, 'too_deep', `the limit is ${this.maxDepth}`);

mutations.name: YS-compact-depth-unbounded
mutations.what: `- - - x` items are not counted against the depth

patches.old: if (depth + 1 > this.maxDepth) throw new YamlSubsetError(at + 1, 'too_deep', `the limit is ${this.maxDepth}`);

mutations.name: YS-loose-utf8
mutations.what: bytes that are not UTF-8 are decoded with replacement characters

patches.old: new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: true, ignoreBOM: true })
patches.new: new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: false, ignoreBOM: true })

mutations.name: YS-bom-anywhere
mutations.what: a BOM inside the file is accepted

mutations.name: YS-leading-bom-kept
mutations.what: a leading BOM is not dropped (the first key would carry it)

mutations.name: YS-crlf-refused
mutations.what: CRLF line breaks are refused like a lone CR

mutations.name: YS-control-allowed
mutations.what: control characters are accepted

mutations.name: YS-flow-allowed
mutations.what: a flow sequence is read as text

mutations.name: YS-comment-without-space
mutations.what: `#` without whitespace before it starts a comment (cuts `x#y`)

mutations.name: YS-colon-in-plain
mutations.what: `a: b: c` is read as the text `b: c`

patches.old: if (/:(?:[ \t]|$)/.test(value)) throw new YamlSubsetError(line, 'syntax', 'a value cannot hold ": "; quote it');

mutations.name: YS-octal-like-integer
mutations.what: `007` is read as the number 7

mutations.name: YS-quoted-is-number
mutations.what: a quoted "1" is typed like a plain 1

patches.old: if (text[0] === '"' || text[0] === "'") return { kind: 'scalar', line, value: quoted(text, line), style: 'quoted' };
patches.new: if (text[0] === '"' || text[0] === "'") { const v = quoted(text, line); return { kind: 'scalar', line, value: INTEGER.test(v) ? Number(v) : v, style: 'plain' }; }

mutations.name: YS-unknown-escape-kept
mutations.what: an unknown escape is kept as it is

mutations.name: YS-trailing-after-quote
mutations.what: text after a closing quote is ignored

mutations.name: YS-single-quote-escape
mutations.what: `''` inside a single-quoted string is not unescaped

mutations.name: YS-folded-as-literal
mutations.what: a folded block keeps its line breaks

mutations.name: YS-fold-paragraph-lost
mutations.what: a blank line inside a folded block becomes a space

mutations.name: YS-fold-more-indented
mutations.what: a more-indented line of a folded block is folded too

mutations.name: YS-chomp-keep-ignored
mutations.what: `|+` keeps only one line break

mutations.name: YS-chomp-strip-ignored
mutations.what: `|-` keeps the final line break

mutations.name: YS-indent-indicator-ignored
mutations.what: the indentation indicator of a block header is ignored

patches.old: let column = width ? indent + Number(width) : null;

mutations.name: YS-bad-indent-accepted
mutations.what: a more-indented key is read as a sibling

mutations.name: YS-proto-pollution
mutations.what: plain values are built on ordinary objects (a `__proto__` key changes the prototype)
